text_block_list.text: Search... The time... is now...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you it's another premonition!
Today is
the lucky day I uncover the
truth behind the
secret spell!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru is still trying to learn
about
the mysterious piece of paper she
found back at
home.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, the student council won't
stop us this
time! I already performed a
flower divination as
per the teachings of
the great Shiraoki!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It says I should borrow a friend's helping
hand for
good luck! ...But, uh, after all
the trouble I caused
the other day, that
might be difficult...

Lo and behold, in your eleventh hour...
the sun
itself, in other words, yours truly,
has come to
your aid!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that is if you wish to have
companions
along this journey of new
discoveries over yonder!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
M-me too! Fukukitaru, you listened to
my
troubles during the karuta
tournament... S-so I
want to return the
favor!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! You can sit back and relax now
that we're
here! I'm great at solving
riddles!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: E-everyone...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Is this the ritual diagram? It has some
drawings, a
few numbers, and...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Chimes, "20," dancer, "3," flowers, "0,"
and
carp... What does this all mean?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Haaah ha ha! Sounds to me
like a
mythos of romance betwixt man
and beast!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hark, let this flower bed host my sweet nothings to you, a sound to rival Cupid's chimes! My heart dances for you, even if you are a carp!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what about the numbers? Like the
twenty
and three?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Argh... I don't know... Is there no hope?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Chimes, dancers, flowers, carp... Oh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I got it! These are all back at home! The
Shinto
bell, the shrine's kagura hall,
flower ornaments,
and the carp pond!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
There is hope after all! So, what do the
numbers
mean?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The number of paces to the clue.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I remember now... This... is a treasure
map my big
sister made.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It was when I was learning how to
write...
She made the map for fun saying
it'll help me
learn my numbers.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wait, if I remember correctly, your sister
is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she passed away a long time ago.
So long
ago... that my memory's become
like this. That's
why—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad! The secret spell helped me
remember
my dear sister!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I would've never realized if you all
hadn't helped
me! I'd still be running
around on a wild goose
chase...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So, thank you all! I feel so warm and
fuzzy inside!
This is what they call a
happy ending, right?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
So, thank you all! I feel so warm and
fuzzy inside!
This is what they call a
happy ending, right?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
choice_data_list: まだ宝の正体は謎のままだぞ！
まだ宝の正体は謎のままだよ！
地図、大事にしないとな
地図、大事にしないとね

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the finale is yet to come! Let us
go forth
and see this to the end!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Yeah! Since we've come this far
together,
let's keep pushing forward!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Me and my sister never
finished our
treasure hunt.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm gonna look for it by myself,
just like old
times!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Good luck! I hope you'll discover
something
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Matikanefukukitaru
tells me
that while she still hasn't
managed to find the
treasure, she did
find a bunch of letters and maps
she
exchanged with her sister in those
bygone
days.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I'm never ever gonna forget about
it again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, your sister must be really happy
to hear
that! I bet she's smiling like you
right now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru holds her precious
map
tenderly to her chest, her smile as
bright as the
sun.
